founderSession: Existing authenticated Google session; Cloud Shell explicitly authorised by founder
googleMfa: Founder attestation plus authenticated Security page showing 2-Step Verification ON, authenticator and passkeys configured; no simulated fresh MFA challenge
independentRecovery: Founder confirmed accessible recovery method if usual phone is lost

iam.humanAccess: Existing founder Owner (Legacy), inherited from project
iam.limitation: Existing Owner is broad administration, not a secret-scoped least-privilege role. No owner removal or new IAM grants performed. Only the actual verifier principal was actively denied; no impersonation grants were created.

audit.enabledBy: Founder in Console, then independently read back
audit.limitation: Access logging verified; no assertion of locked immutable log-bucket retention or a separately exported audit archive

emergencyProcedure: Use the founder's independent recovery method; inspect principal/version audit history; revoke compromised scoped access under incident authority; disable the affected version reversibly. Do not delete the secret: whole-secret deletion is not covered by the version destruction delay. Preserve versions needed for existing encrypted backups. Live-key transfer and an isolated restore using that exact version require separate approval.
